What if some rooms are hotter or have weaker airflow

Uneven airflow can come from several causes. AC cleaning can help when buildup is restricting the return path or supply path, but it is not the only possible reason.

Common contributors

  • Closed or obstructed supply registers

  • A filter that is the wrong size or not seated correctly

Quick check you can do today. Walk to the main return and see if it is partially blocked by a bookcase or a console table. We have seen returns trying to breathe through a one inch gap. What is the difference between AC cleaning and changing the filter

Changing the filter is regular upkeep. AC cleaning addresses what builds up beyond the filter, especially in returns, duct interiors, and around the air moving parts.

Both matter. A clean system with a neglected filter can get dirty again faster. A new filter with dirty returns still leaves a lot of old buildup in place. If you are focused on ongoing system health, AC Maintenance can support a routine approach.
